_comment: Ratchet baseline for `npm run lint`. CI fails if the error count rises above this.
It may only ever be lowered.
WHAT THESE 74 ACTUALLY ARE — corrected, because the previous note here overstated it.
It claimed the react-hooks/set-state-in-effect errors 'are not style debt — they ARE
the state-race class behind the filed frontend bugs'. That is misleading, and it sends
the next reader hunting 45 latent bugs that mostly are not there.
I sampled 11 of the 45 across three files — notebooklm/page.tsx (6, the largest
concentration), skill-editor.tsx and wiki-search-dialog.tsx. EVERY ONE is a deliberate
reset-or-load on key change: clear the previous artifact/notebook/query's state when the
key changes. That is not a race; it is the FIX for the stale-state bugs in #76/#77. The
rule flags it because a synchronous setState in an effect can cascade a render, which
here is a performance note, not a defect.
So: 34 of the 45 are unsampled and may include a real one, but the pattern found is
correct code the rule cannot distinguish from a cascade. Rewriting these to satisfy the
rule means a `key` prop to force remount, or deriving state — sometimes an improvement,
sometimes just churn. Judge each on its own merits; do not assume it is a bug because
it is counted here.
Breakdown of the 74:
45  react-hooks/set-state-in-effect          mostly reset-on-key-change (above)
10  @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
8  react-hooks/refs                         ref reads during render
6  react/no-unescaped-entities              cosmetic
3  react-hooks/immutability                 React Compiler correctness rules; the
1  react-hooks/purity                       compiler is in devDependencies but is
1  react-hooks/preserve-manual-memoization  NOT enabled in next.config.ts
86 -> 84: the P1 frontend fixes. 84 -> 78: #94 deleted ~1,100 LOC of unreferenced
components. 78 -> 74: #91's state-race and swallowed-error fixes.
When this reaches 0, replace the ratchet step in .github/workflows/ci.yml with a plain
`npm run lint` and delete this file.
